manaNeeded: {3}{R}{R} plus enough mana to cast the instant or sorcery from your hand
notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand.
description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell.
Holding priority, cast Increasing Vengeance for its flashback cost by paying {3}{R}{R}.
Sevinne triggers, creating a copy of Increasing Vengeance, targeting Increasing Vengeance.
Resolve the copy of Increasing Vengeance, creating a copy of Increasing Vengeance, targeting Increasing Vengeance.
Repeat step 4.
